review_candidates.description: Job Description Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Testing Lead to oversee the testing strategy, planning, governance, and execution for a greenfield Digital Bank launch. The ideal candidate will bring the rigor and risk discipline of a classic/traditional banking environment, combined with prior experience at a testing company or consulting firm, to lead the QA function end-to-end and ensure a compliant, high-quality launch. Direct experience leading testing for a Digital Bank or Core Banking transformation program is highly preferred. Key Responsibilities Define and own the overall Test Strategy, Test Plan, Test Governance, and Testing Roadmap for the digital bank launch program. Lead end-to-end testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Regression Testing, Performance Testing, Integration Testing, and Production Validation. Oversee testing of core banking platform integrations, payments, onboarding/KYC flows, card issuance, and digital channels (web/mobile). Manage testing execution across multiple testing partners, vendors, and cross-functional delivery teams. Establish testing governance, quality standards, reporting mechanisms, and risk management processes. Prepare test schedules, resource plans, effort estimates, and testing milestones. Ensure comprehensive test coverage aligned with business, functional, and regulatory requirements. Monitor testing progress, defect metrics, and quality KPIs, providing regular status updates to stakeholders. Drive defect triage meetings and coordinate issue resolution with development, business, and infrastructure teams. Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Architects, PMO, Compliance, and Delivery Teams throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure regulatory and audit readiness — testing evidence, traceability matrices, and compliance sign-offs typical of banking environments. Own go-live readiness assessment and post-launch hypercare testing support. Mentor testing teams and promote QA best practices and continuous process improvement. Required Skills 10+ years of experience in Software Testing and Test Management, including significant time within a classic/traditional retail or corporate bank. Prior experience at a testing company or consulting firm, bringing structured, repeatable test methodologies across multiple client environments. Demonstrated experience leading a testing function or team (Test Manager, QA Lead, Head of Testing) — not solely as an individual contributor. Strong expertise in Test Strategy, Test Planning, Test Governance, and Test Execution. Strong knowledge of SDLC, STLC, Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies. Expertise in SIT, UAT, Regression, Integration, End-to-End, Performance, and Production Testing. Experience with test and defect management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM/Quality Center, TestRail, or similar. Strong stakeholder management, communication, leadership, and project coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple testing workstreams simultaneously. Preferred Qualifications Experience overseeing the launch of a Digital Bank or Core Banking Transformation program. Strong understanding of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Deposits, and Digital Channels. Experience with API Testing, Microservices, Middleware, and Integration Testing. Exposure to Test Automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. Experience working with cloud-based banking environments. Knowledge of banking regulatory, compliance, and security standards (AML/KYC testing, data privacy, audit trail requirements). Experience with Core Banking platforms such as Oracle FLEXCUBE, Temenos, Finacle, T24, or similar is an advantage. ISTQB certification is preferred. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification is preferred.
